title: Surface motion between pictures
caption: Motion on a disc 220 pixels in radius, from the table above: the equator at the disc centre and the mid-latitude lag behind it.
alt: Grouped bars on a log axis, in pixels. Equator at the disc centre: 0.2 px at 5 minutes, 2.1 at 1 hour, 10.7 at 5 hours, 51 at 24 hours. Mid-latitude lag behind the equator: 0.02, 0.2, 1 and 5 px.
